findings.description: The containment correction was applied only to the stripped .specify mirror. Both specrew init and specrew update load the packaged extensions/specrew-speckit/scripts/deploy-squad-runtime.ps1 copy, whose Set-ManagedFile still reads and writes TargetPath directly without rejecting a symlink, junction, or linked ancestor. A project-controlled link beneath a managed target can therefore redirect an init/update write outside the project. Apply the containment guard to the canonical packaged source and enforce source/deployed parity.
findings.title: Shipped deploy helper still writes through project-controlled links

findings.description: The authorization path constructs a fresh default host catalog, preserves only previously allowed rows with non-empty authorization_ref values, and serializes the entire replacement. With no explicit --model it resets the addressed host's pinned model to the default; an unrelated deliberately suspended row (allowed=false with an explanatory authorization_ref) is not copied at all. This can erase reviewer-independence policy and later make an unsafe host selectable. Update only the addressed row's authorization_ref while preserving every other field and row.
findings.title: Recording one reviewer grant overwrites unrelated host policy

findings.description: Compare-SpecrewTurnSnapshot stores paths in ordinary PowerShell hashtables, whose string keys are case-insensitive, and then deduplicates the combined keys case-insensitively. On a case-sensitive repository, Foo and foo overwrite or collapse; an edit to the shadowed path can yield an empty changed set, material=false, and no required conformance packet. The latest sweep changed only the stripped .specify mirror's Sort-Object call and did not fix these maps or the canonical extension shipped to consumers. Use a filesystem-appropriate dictionary comparer and publish the correction from the canonical source.
findings.title: Turn-delta maps erase case-distinct file changes

summary: Risk-based review completed with three major, consumer-reachable findings. Both configured controller commands succeeded for the exact frozen digest, but the shipped extension source still contains deployment containment and case-sensitive turn-delta defects, and reviewer authorization still rewrites unrelated host policy.
